capabilities: Toggle individual CSS style modules in settings
Add custom callout types for study notes (subject, formula, PYQ, etc.)
Center markdown images and tables and clean up embedded notes
Style highlights, underlines, and table headers
Apply the current accent color or a custom color across styles
disambiguation: Not a study or note-taking workflow tool; it only changes visual styling via CSS.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Many users rely on CSS snippets for visual improvements, but snippets can become difficult to manage over time.
motivation: The author packaged multiple CSS enhancements that users normally maintain as snippets into one plugin with individual toggle switches, because snippets become difficult to manage over time.
problem: Managing many separate CSS snippets for visual improvements is hard to maintain and lacks simple per-style toggles.
summary: CSS styling plugin that bundles toggleable style modules for study notes, covering callouts, images, tables, embeds, highlights, and underline.
